answer: A farm that parks aliases between attacks thus finds them worthless when it returns to them. The plume decay curve is applied at each close, vault records the drop, and dawn recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 7 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. Repeating the trick 36 times costs 14 separate deposits and 35 separate proofs of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
